title: Bean and Yellow Cheese Quesadillas
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Mexican-inspired dish filled with beans and melted yellow cheese. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add a small amount of olive oil to the skillet.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with a quarter of the yellow cheese.
Add a quarter of the black beans on half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is crispy.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
